title: Madison Carriage | 30a Vacation Rental | 30a Beach Properties – 30A Beach Properties
meta_description: With one bed and one bath, Madison Carriage is a vacation rental on 30a that you don't want to miss! Click here to learn more today.
description_expanded:
30-a Beach Properties presents the Madison Carriage, located south of 30-A in Rosemary Beach, close to the beach, shops and Barbados pool. A full kitchen and great floor plan make this newer built carriage house clean, bright and comfortable. You will love the coziness of this charming two story carriage apt over the garage. Lots of windows and proximity to Rosemary Beach cafes and the beach itself make this a very popular property!

We provide passes to access all 4 Rosemary Beach Community pools, and any of the 9 Beach Walkovers

All towels, bed linens, blankets, comforters, and pillow/mattress protectors are professionally laundered for every new reservation!

Located south of 30-A at 45 N Spanish Town Lane in Rosemary Beach.

1 NEW King bed in upstairs loft

1 built-in full twin bunk bed downstairs

Sleeper sofa

Newer built carriage house is clean, bright and comfortable.

One minute easy walk to beach via boardwalk G or I.

Across from Barbados pool.

Close to Main Street cafes and shops.

782 square feet

Fully stocked kitchen with breakfast bar.

Upper level: loft with NEW King bed with a sink & mirror vanity (no toilet/shower upstairs).

Lower level: bunk, full bathroom, kitchen, dining, living.

No pets.

No smoking.

Features:

1 Garage Parking Space, Fits Suv: Tahoe, X7, Expedition. Extended suvs will not fit.

NEW washer/dryer

granite countertops

hardwood floors

iron & ironing board

Rear Courtyard features a nice outdoor sofa seating area.

Access to all 4 Rosemary Beach pools.

Tennis and fitness centers are daily fee.
